lessonTitle: 83. Circle inscribed in a regular polygon
lessonTitleEnglish: Circle inscribed in a regular polygon
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 8 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: Theorem: every regular polygon has one inscribed circle, concentric with the circumscribed one.
stages.headlineEnglish: Theorem: every regular polygon has one inscribed circle, concentric with the circumscribed one.

stages.headline: The inradius r is the distance from the centre to a side (the apothem); for a square r = a/2.
stages.headlineEnglish: The inradius r is the distance from the centre to a side (the apothem); for a square r = a/2.

stages.headline: For a regular triangle r = R/2; for a hexagon r = R√3/2.
stages.headlineEnglish: For a regular triangle r = R/2; for a hexagon r = R√3/2.
